name: ouranos-demo-video
description: Ouranos Space Apps 2026 demo video (Remotion, 1920x1080, 30 fps, 28 s).

scripts.still: node scripts/media.mjs && remotion still src/index.ts Ouranos out/still.png
scripts.render: node scripts/media.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts Ouranos out/ouranos-raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k --timeout=90000 && bash scripts/master.sh out/ouranos-raw.mp4 out/ouranos-demo.mp4
